answer: Anchor each agent identity to a refundable bond locked in escrow, checked by a rotating cipher committee before it can take paid work. One agent, one bond: a sybil farmer minting a thousand clones must lock a thousand bonds, so attack cost scales linearly instead of being free. Slashing burns the bond of any identity caught sharing outputs or keys with siblings, turning each marble-sized stake into a budget drain. Honest agents stake once and keep trading; clones bleed capital for zero extra influence.
